# Ahmad Ayyad - Full-Stack MERN Developer

> Portfolio and technical profile of Ahmad Ayyad, Full-Stack Software Engineer specializing in MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js, and modern cloud architectures.

## Professional Summary
Ahmad Ayyad is a passionate software engineering professional and full-stack web developer with expertise in building responsive, high-performance web applications, secure RESTful APIs, and scalable backends.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Responsive UI/UX
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, JWT Authentication, Role-based Access Control
- **Database & Storage**: MongoDB, Mongoose, Cloudinary Media Storage
- **DevOps & Tools**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Railway, Postman, Vite

## Featured Projects
